description.title: ביטוח אחריות זיהום
description.summary: This table details exclusions to a pollution liability insurance policy. It specifies substances and situations not covered, such as naturally occurring substances and wrongful acts.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום מגדירה חריגים שונים לכיסוי. לדוגמה, חומרים טבעיים המופיעים במצבם הלא-משתנה אינם מכוסים, אלא אם כן הוכח שהם חרגו מהריכוזים הטבעיים בסביבת 'המיקום המכוסה'. הפוליסה אינה מכסה גם פעולות שגויות מכוונות או אי-ציות לרשויות.
notable_values: Naturally Occurring Substance: exclusion applies in unaltered form
Underground Storage Tanks: known tanks not listed on endorsement are excluded
Microbial Substance: any microbial substance is excluded
Wrongful Acts: knowingly wrongful acts are excluded
Owned Property: damage to owned/rented property is excluded

sketch:
I. Naturally Occurring Substance
Any naturally occurring substance in its unaltered form, or altered solely through naturally  occurring  processes  or  phenomena.    However,  this  exclusion  does  not apply  to  the  extent  that  an  "insured"  demonstrates  that  the  naturally  occurring substance:
Exceeds amounts or concentrations naturally present on, at, under or surrounding the 'covered location", and
Was  the  result  of  a  discharge,  dispersal,  release  or  escape  of  such  naturally occurring substance.

טבלה: ביטוח אחריות זיהום
This table details exclusions to a pollution liability insurance policy. It specifies substances and situations not covered, such as naturally occurring substances and wrongful acts.

I. Naturally Occurring Substance
Any naturally occurring substance in its unaltered form, or altered solely through naturally  occurring  processes  or  phenomena.    However,  this  exclusion  does  not apply  to  the  extent  that  an  "insured"  demonstrates  that  the  naturally  occurring substance:

Was  the  result  of  a  discharge,  dispersal,  release  or  escape  of  such  naturally occurring substance.
